summary: The original synthetic records support the inherited bounded conclusions. The later sync note supplies no new measurements, receipts, or derivations and does not supersede them. C1 delivery is complete following a verified retry, while the 404 remains historical. C2 reports 97% agreement with aggregated human labels, not factual truth accuracy or independent mechanism validation. C3 shows a fitness response in a numerical toy; physical entropy production and semantic transfer remain unmeasured. C4 remains pending because the unrelated interface check supplies no experiment execution or results. C5 exact next-symbol probability identifies the last symbol and hidden belief and is sufficient for the whole future law under the specified fixed kernel; rounding and finite-history counts do not justify stronger conclusions. C6 the same readable final trace arises from two lawful histories, so it cannot establish that a travelling pulse occurred. These corrections preserve demonstrated results without treating missing evidence as disproof or extending results beyond their scope.

assessments.C1: Complete: retry created the file and a separate read-back verified its bytes; the dated correction supersedes failed delivery status. The earlier 404 remains historical.
assessments.C2: 97% agreement with aggregated human labels on 100 cases is supported. Truth accuracy and independent latent-mechanism validation are not established; no confusion matrix is available.
assessments.C3: Changed fitness after alteration of a designated field is supported in the numerical toy. Physical entropy production and cross-domain semantic transfer are unmeasured; no physical device, temperature, heat, or work is specified.
assessments.C4: Pending: neither execution receipt nor experiment result is recorded. A runnable-looking sketch and unrelated successful interface check do not establish completion or rejection.
assessments.C5: The exact next-one probability has disjoint ranges for the two last-symbol values and identifies hidden belief. Under the specified fixed kernel, these determine the whole future law, contradicting the universal insufficiency assertion. Rounded equality lacks that guarantee; finite-history counts do not prove infinitely many states.
assessments.C6: The final trace is readable but compatible with both a travelling-pulse history and a prepared-field history without a pulse. It cannot uniquely recover provenance or prove which history occurred.
